# Prakash Nayak

> Full-stack developer and founder of Hiver Technology, based in Lalitpur, Nepal. Builds fast, SEO-friendly products with WordPress, React, Next.js, Laravel and Django.

## About

- 7+ years shipping production web software
- Founder & CEO, Hiver Technology (2020 – present): leads a team of 5 across web, e-commerce, SaaS and marketing
- WordPress & UI/UX Developer, The Development Agency (Dec 2024 – present)
- B.E. Computer Science & Engineering, BMS Institute of Technology and Management (2014 – 2018)
